inlines.v: VOYAGE, noun 1. A passing by sea or water from one place, port or country to another, especially a passing or journey by water to a distant place or country. Captain Latin made more than a hundred voyages to the West Indies. A voyage over lake Superior is like a voyage to Bermuda. 2. The practice of traveling. [Not in use.] VOYAGE, verb intransitive To sail or pass by water. VOYAGE, verb transitive To travel; to pass over. I with pain Voyagd th unreal, vast, unbounded deep.
